verdict.rationale: cubic has a few batch-style behaviors. Auto-fix can fix the issues from every review of a pull request rather than one at a time (cubic-docs-66). An org-level cubic-config repository applies one cubic.yaml across repositories (cubic-docs-67). However, nothing documents a general bulk-operation feature such as selecting many PRs or findings to triage, resolve, or re-review at once, via the UI, MCP, or CLI. Missing for 10: explicit multi-item bulk actions (bulk triage, dismiss, resolve or re-review across PRs or issues), bulk operations exposed through the MCP server or CLI, and any hands-on corroboration.
